batches.name: stdin-cli-entry
batches.scope: sys.stdin / sys.argv / argparse parse_args & parse_known_args CLI boundaries

batches.name: network-hub
batches.scope: requests.* / huggingface_hub hf_hub_download & cached_download network boundaries

batches.name: internal-transfer
batches.scope: dynamic-dispatch and internal hand-off call sites

batches.name: exec-api-sinks
batches.scope: subprocess Popen & run & check_output / asyncio.create_subprocess_exec call sites

batches.name: exec-wrappers
batches.scope: internal functions wrapping an OS-command execution
